unknowns: The meaning of the four bytes of resource type 255 (strings.dll 0x1d674, payload 09040000): three carriers in the installation, all the same value, so no reading is distinguishable from any other.

Whether anything reads strings.dll's type-16 leaf: the structure is established, its consumption is not measured and needs an original run.

Whether a localized installation preserves these ids and these two resources: only one English installation was surveyed.
Seven RESOURCE.H string ids (600, 620, 2002, 2050, 2054, 3510, 3540) name no langui.dll block; not guessed whether they are dead defines or belong to another image.
